summary: How can i get copilot to edit architect ai
plan:
To let GitHub Copilot edit your files directly inside your workspace, you need to use **GitHub Copilot Chat** (specifically the inline chat or panel) and give it the right trigger commands. 

Here is the exact workflow to have Copilot update your files:

1. Open your project folder in VS Code with the GitHub Copilot extension installed.
2. Highlight or open the file you want to change (for example, `server.js`).
3. Press `Ctrl + I` (Windows/Linux) or `Cmd + I` (Mac) to open the inline Copilot chat directly inside the editor, or use the chat panel on the sidebar (`Ctrl + Alt + I` / `Cmd + Shift + I`).
4. Paste the prompt below into Copilot to give it direct execution permissions and your instructions:

Act as the AI Architect for Bargain Drop. You have full permission to modify the code in this workspace. Review the current project files (server.js, gemini.js, pricing.js) and make sure they strictly adhere to our CIP pipeline workflow and environment variable practices. When I ask for a change, provide the updated code directly.
